text.p: Here are the main headlines from the noon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The prosecutor's office applied on Thursday to parliament to strip the immunity of MP Audrius Butkevickius who is alleged to have taken a $15,000 bribe.
- Estonian Hoiupank intends to open its representative office in Vilnius this winter and still mulls the idea of acquiring a controlling stake in Lithuania's State Commercial Bank.
